Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class CompanyProfileService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.CompanyProfileService
public class CompanyProfileService extends Object
Pure domain service for managing company intelligence profiles.

Handles profile creation/update from discovery pipeline results, keyword-based event detection from article titles, and top-company ranking. Has no Spring dependencies — wired via AppConfig.

  • Method Details

    • upsertFromDiscovery

      public CompanyProfile upsertFromDiscovery(Company company, List<NewsArticle> relatedArticles, CompanyProfile existing)
      Creates or updates a CompanyProfile from a discovery pipeline result.

      If an existing profile is provided, new article IDs are appended (without duplicates) and the description is updated. If null, a new profile is created from the Company record.

      Parameters:
      company - the discovered company
      relatedArticles - articles linked to this company
      existing - the current profile, or null if first discovery
      Returns:
      the updated or newly created profile

    • detectEvents

      public List<CompanyEvent> detectEvents(CompanyProfile profile, List<NewsArticle> newArticles)

      Parameters:
      profile - the company profile
      newArticles - articles to scan for events
      Returns:
      list of detected events (may be empty)

    • getTopCompanies

      public List<CompanyProfile> getTopCompanies(List<CompanyProfile> profiles, int limit)

      Parameters:
      profiles - all profiles
      limit - maximum number to return
      Returns:
      top profiles sorted by articleCount descending
